summary: Pre-launch Site Access Gate fully tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (13 tests) and Playwright UI flows all pass. Gate enforcement, redeem flow (private + revoke + idempotent + single-use exhaustion), admin CRUD, has_site_access propagation through /auth/me, superadmin bypass, and admin panel UI all work.

issues: React hydration warning: '<a> cannot contain a nested <a>' — pre-existing, unrelated to access gate but worth investigating

critical_code_review_comments: access_codes.py: redeem endpoint normalises with _norm_code() before strict re.match in trial path is bypassed — fine, but any future custom-code with hyphens entered by users will be silently coerced; consider showing the canonical form back to admins so they can copy/share without ambiguity.

Trial-code branch was NOT covered by the automated suite (would require minting via /api/trial/request-code which depends on Resend in dev — main agent already smoke-tested manually). Recommend adding a unit-level test that inserts a trial_codes doc directly via a fixture for full coverage.
set_access_cookie hard-codes secure=True. In local non-HTTPS dev this means the device cookie won't persist; not a problem for the public preview env (HTTPS) but worth a comment.
test_credentials: Superadmin reggie@coolgeek.me / superadminpass123. Fresh users registered ad-hoc with TEST_ prefix at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_-prefixed access_codes documents and ~5 TEST_ users via /api/auth/register. Codes mostly revoked or spent and safe to leave; users have access_granted_at stamps but pose no production risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All gate flows verified. If main agent extends this feature (e.g. cohort analytics, expiry notifications), re-run /app/backend/tests/test_access_codes_gate.py. Trial-code branch verified backend code path but not via automated test — add fixture-backed trial code insert if extending.
